dct_description_sm:
Boundaries representing Community Block Plans related to the land use policies contained in the Brampton Official Plan, Schedule H.

Community block plans assist in the co-coordination of 

  • the delivery of services and infrastructure
  • allocation of development priority
  • layout of roads and the location and configuration
  • character, size and urban form of parks, institutional, commercial and industrial sites
  • layout/function of open space corridors, valleylands, woodlots and other natural features   

Major revisions were included in the 2025 Office Consolidation.

Last Updated: May 4, 2026
